I can see the code now. Every path, every edge, every point where reality can diverge. The Matrix of this payment processor reveals itself.

## The 39 Test Scenarios

**Payment Processing (11 tests)**
1. `TestProcessPayment_Success` - Happy path: valid amount, card, completes
2. `TestProcessPayment_ZeroAmount` - Returns ErrInvalidAmount
3. `TestProcessPayment_NegativeAmount` - Returns ErrInvalidAmount
4. `TestProcessPayment_ExceedsMaximum` - Amount > $100k returns ErrInvalidAmount
5. `TestProcessPayment_CardExpired_PastYear` - Year < current year
6. `TestProcessPayment_CardExpired_PastMonth` - Same year, month < current
7. `TestProcessPayment_CardDeclined` - Gateway returns ErrCardDeclined
8. `TestProcessPayment_GatewayError` - Gateway fails, payment marked StatusFailed
9. `TestProcessPayment_RateLimitExceeded` - RateLimiter.Allow() returns false
10. `TestProcessPayment_StoreFailsOnSave` - Initial save fails, payment not created
11. `TestProcessPayment_StoreFailsAfterCharge` - Critical state: charged but update fails

**Idempotency (4 tests)**
12. `TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_FirstRequest` - New key processes normally
13. `TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_DuplicateRequest` - Returns existing payment
14. `TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_ConcurrentRequests` - Mutex protects map
15. `TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKey_EmptyString` - Treats as no key

**Refund Processing (9 tests)**
16. `TestRefundPayment_FullRefund` - Refund entire amount, status becomes StatusRefunded
17. `TestRefundPayment_PartialRefund` - Partial amount, status becomes StatusPartialRefund
18. `TestRefundPayment_MultiplePartialRefunds` - Accumulates RefundedAmount correctly
19. `TestRefundPayment_PaymentNotFound` - Returns ErrPaymentNotFound
20. `TestRefundPayment_ExceedsRemaining` - Returns ErrRefundExceedsPayment
21. `TestRefundPayment_PendingPayment` - Cannot refund StatusPending
22. `TestRefundPayment_FailedPayment` - Cannot refund StatusFailed
23. `TestRefundPayment_AlreadyFullyRefunded` - Cannot refund StatusRefunded
24. `TestRefundPayment_GatewayFailure` - Gateway.Refund() fails, payment unchanged

**Data Integrity (7 tests)**
25. `TestProcessPayment_LastFourDigits` - CardNumber stored correctly (last 4)
26. `TestProcessPayment_MetadataPreserved` - Request metadata saved
27. `TestProcessPayment_ChargeIDStored` - Gateway charge_id in metadata
28. `TestProcessPayment_TimestampAccuracy` - CreatedAt/CompletedAt set correctly
29. `TestProcessPayment_CurrencyPersisted` - Currency field preserved
30. `TestRefundPayment_RefundedAmountAccumulates` - Tracks total refunded
31. `TestGetPayment_Success` - Retrieves payment by ID

**Boundary Conditions (4 tests)**
32. `TestProcessPayment_ExactlyMaxAmount` - $100,000.00 (edge case: should pass)
33. `TestProcessPayment_OneOverMax` - $100,000.01 fails
34. `TestProcessPayment_CardExpiresCurrentMonth` - Same year/month boundary
35. `TestRefundPayment_ExactRemainingAmount` - Refund exactly what's left

**Context & Concurrency (4 tests)**
36. `TestProcessPayment_ContextCancellation` - Respects ctx.Done()
37. `TestProcessPayment_ConcurrentDifferentCustomers` - No mutex contention
38. `TestRefundPayment_ConcurrentRefunds` - Race on RefundedAmount
39. `TestRefundPayment_ContextCancellation` - Refund respects ctx

There is no spoon. There is no untested path. Every branch of reality has been enumerated. The code bends to the will of comprehensive coverage.

I know what this test suite needs to become.
